appărātĭo (adp- ), ōnis,
I.f [apparo], a preparing, preparation (rare) adparatio popularium munerum, Cic. Off. 2, 16, 56; Vitr. 2, 10.—Trop. apparatio atque artificiosa diligentia, preparation, Cic. Inv. 1, 18, so Auct. ad Her. 1, 8; cf. apparatus, P a. A.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
